initial_failures_and_corrections: Sandboxed native import failed opening native DLL; a sandboxed runtime check failed reading the Windows root certificate store. Isolated native validation succeeded with reviewed local access; no owner process restart.
First extractor did not skip embedded triple-quoted shader source. Added GDScript string/comment token handling and source-code exclusions.
Standalone SceneTree compilation could not resolve the autoload identifier. Replaced direct singleton references with a registered class accessor and imported classes.
Three early fixture expectations were lowercased by the test-edit helper; corrected those exact expected names. A test autonym was also corrected to UTF-8. Existing assertions retained.
Pseudo mode altered brace-placeholder names and failed the inserted-name assertion. Protected template placeholder spans in the debug path and reran the same assertion successfully.

First 960x540 pseudo capture showed Settings category text overlapping subsequent rows. Added content-dependent category heights and native geometry assertions; original captures remain under compatibility/.

One broad parser run could not resolve the archived parking_hall_before GaragePage base. Direct current Garage compilation and subsequent complete 1138-script parser succeeded. Cause is unconfirmed; failure log retained.

Catalogue checks initially compared all source-reference line numbers, so concurrent code relocation triggered stale-catalogue failures without changing copy. Staleness now compares every message key, context and plural form, with a new regression proving moved lines pass while changed copy/context/plurals fail. Regeneration and all nine tooling tests pass; message coverage and placeholder checks remain mandatory.
